entries.review: Silver/pale-champagne finish and white background improved. Main Greek lettering/dates, portrait layout and twelve stars visually retained. Exact curls, face/cloth contours and tiny glyph/mint fidelity remain unverified; no live replacement.
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the ONLY edit target, an existing actual commemorative euro coin photograph. Images 2 and 3 are finish references only. Conservative photographic cleanup: clean neutral satin-silver outer ring, VERY PALE low-saturation cream-beige champagne-gold centre and pure white background matching references. Remove blotchy dirt and uneven colour casts only from flat metal. Preserve EVERY original engraved line and shape, all inscriptions/accents/spacing, dates, mint marks, initials, rim, orientation and all twelve stars EXACTLY. Follow source pixels; never guess unreadable letters or invent details. Keep original relief shading and complete coin outline with modest white margin. No redesigned relief, simplified geometry, new lettering or extra stars. One coin only, no collage, no saturated yellow or mirror chrome. Target: Penelope Delta. Lock the exact portrait profile, every curl, face/neck contour and clothing fold. Preserve all Greek perimeter lettering, 1874-1941, 2024 and the tiny mint symbol exactly as source. Do not reconstruct facial detail or change portrait identity or orientation.
